messages:
carla: Hey folks — noticed our docs PR #4823 (console/observability/snippets) switched the tracehook examples to v2 but a few dashboard anchors in the quickstart examples now 404 (playground links + anchor IDs). Can someone take a quick pass? I can revert if needed.
ben: I saw that — which anchors are broken?
carla: examples/quickstart.md anchors: #trace-context-setup and #heatmap-kv. Also the playground embed URL lost the `anchor=trace` param so the preview jumps to top.
alice: @carla I can take the quickstart fixes. Is it OK to update the anchors to match tracehook v2 canonical names? I'll also add a short migration note for users relying on old ids.
carla: Yep — prefer rename to #trace-context-v2 and #heatmap-kv-v2 to avoid collisions with other snippets.
docs-bot: PR 4823 updated by @mike: added tracehook v2 snippets and bumped sample versions — CI: docs-lint passed, linkcheck failed (2 broken anchors).
mike: I introduced the v2 snippet, sorry about the fallout. I can push a patch to fix anchor names + playground param. Do we want to keep the old anchors as deprecated aliases (hidden HTML anchors) for one release?
ben: I'd avoid permanent aliases unless necessary; migration note in the docs + a short-term alias is fine. @sre-ops do we have a hosting redirect we can do for playground anchors?
sre-ops: We can add a small rewrite on the hosting layer for playground anchor params, but that requires an infra rollout. Short term the easiest path is to add legacy HTML anchors in the docs pages so old links keep working. Long term we'll add the rewrite.
alice: I'll open a follow-up PR that: 1) renames anchors, 2) adds hidden legacy anchors (HTML anchors) for one release, 3) adds a 'Migration from tracehook v1' blurb, 4) updates the playground example URL (`anchor=trace` -> `anchor=trace-v2`).
carla: Thanks. Can you also update the SDK snippet in the quickstart? The Node/Python examples still use the old `trace_key` param — new v2 param is `trace_id`.
alice: Good catch, will update both snippets. Patch ETA ~2h.
mike: I'll mark PR 4823 as WIP and add a link to the follow-up in the description so reviewers hold off.
ben: :thumbsup: @alice @mike please ping when fixes are up; I'll re-run the linkcheck and smoke tests.
docs-bot: Linkcheck started by @ben on PR 4823 + follow-up. Results pending.
alice: Patch opened: PR 4831 — includes anchor renames, legacy anchors, SDK snippet updates, and migration note. PTAL.
ben: LGTM on anchors, small nit: remove trailing whitespace in the Node code block line 14. I'll approve after that.
alice: Fixed the whitespace and force-pushed. PTAL.
ben: Approved. Re-running linkcheck...
docs-bot: Linkcheck passed. CI green on PR 4823 + 4831. @carla do you want the legacy aliases removed in the next minor release or two?
carla: Yes, schedule alias removal in two releases and add a deprecation note in the migration blurb.
mike: I'll add a TODO to PR 4831 and a reminder on the release checklist.
carla: Awesome, thanks everyone :tada:
